description: Wojskowa Służba zdrowia is a dataset listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerstwo Obrony Narodowej. Zbiór zawiera dane teleadresowe placówek Wojskowej Służby Zdrowia takich jak: szpitale, sanatoria, pracownie psychologiczne, komisje lekarskie. Coverage: Ministerstwo Obrony Narodowej. The publisher named on the listing is Ministerstwo Obrony Narodowej. Its keywords include obronność. The listing shows 6 download or service links in XLSX, CSV. The listing shows 2024-03-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
